lesson: Cleric catalog data does not prove native creation readiness: the tested API dev image omitted subclass options while finalization required Divine Domain. Saved spell choices also omitted category, and class spellcasting summary metadata was absent.
fix: Keep server domain/ref state; resolve missing saved-choice category only through its provider choice definition ID. Render known refs without synthesizing spellcasting statistics. Require a native creation and live casting pass before declaring end-to-end readiness.
context: API #979 and toolkit #1721 resolved the provider blockers. Native Life Cleric creation and live casts are recorded in docs/how-to/cleric-spellcasting-verification.md.

lesson: A domain-specific equipment bundle can be accepted in the class picker but rejected by finalization when the sheet validates only base class choices.
fix: Apply the selected provider subclass additionalChoices as replacements by choice ID for sheet reconstruction, category fallback and finalization, matching the picker. Do not borrow options from other domains.
context: Fresh Life Cleric browser creation selected the provider chain-mail bundle and exposed the mismatch. Regression coverage verifies the selected domain succeeds and another domain cannot reuse its option.

lesson: Vite dev server running inside WSL does not see file changes when the repo lives on /mnt/c (DrvFs has no inotify). Edits typecheck fine but the browser keeps getting the stale transform-cache module - it looks exactly like your change 'didn't work'.
fix: Restart the dev server after edits when running from WSL, or export CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 before `npm run dev` to make the watcher poll.
context: Hit during Synty asset showcase work (#469): SyntyShowcase.tsx edits didn't appear until the dev server was restarted.

lesson: git push over SSH fails with 'Connection to github.com closed by remote host' (exit 141/SIGPIPE) when the pre-push hook runs the full ci-check (~2-3 min) — the SSH connection idles out during the hook and GitHub drops it. Looks like a random/silent push failure, especially in background shells.
fix: Push with keepalives: GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o ServerAliveInterval=10 -o ServerAliveCountMax=12" git push ... — or set those options for github.com in ~/.ssh/config. Also: run final pushes in the foreground so failures are visible.
context: Hit during #467 status-icons work; the agent's background push 'hung' for ~20 min before diagnosis.

lesson: StoryLog replaces the latest attack's Story entry with ResultEntry. Updating buildCombatStory alone leaves the current attack card unchanged.
fix: Project the shared provider calculation formatter into the attack outcome and post-roll window, and verify the rendered StoryLog with both story and result supplied, plus the ActionDock window flow.
context: Bless/Bane breakdown initially appeared only in historical entries. The API already supplied named dice; the latest result card and post-roll prompt were separate display paths.

lesson: Stabilization changes the public participant life state and death-save progress even while the active turn is unchanged. Refreshing only CharacterData and Afford can leave stale initiative pips.
fix: Refresh Turn for activation_result.stabilized and render Stable from provider life state in both initiative and owner status. Keep the full progress graph in event identity, including present zero counters and false flags; already-stable results remain valid.
context: Two-player Spare the Dying browser acceptance verified zero HP, two casts, reconnect and skipped stable turns with no death saves.
